cell.label: Alarm signs or symptoms present (older than 55 years, anemia, dysphagia, persistent vomiting, gastrointestinal bleeding, involuntary weight loss >5%, jaundice, abdominal mass)?
Potential medications causing dyspepsia (eg, NSAIDs, bisphosphonates, antibiotics)?
Test for H. pylori with urea breath test or stool antigen and treat accordingly. Alternative: empiric proton pump inhibitor only for 4 to 6 weeks. Symptoms resolve?
Appropriate follow-up, consider endoscopy if symptoms recur.
